cardOverview.overviewText: A premium First Wealth card providing luxury lifestyle rewards, global lounge access, concierge support, and milestone benefits for affluent customers.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: Concierge service to help you book your flights, hotels, dining, and other experiences.
benefitRows.howToAvail: You may dial 1800 210 0298 (toll-free) or 022-42320298 for concierge assistance.

benefitRows.name: District
benefitRows.offer: B1G1 offer on movie tickets upto ₹250 on District mobile app (valid twice per month).
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, use the District app to book movie tickets. Apply your IDFC First Wealth credit card for Buy One Get One Free (B1G1) offer up to ₹125, valid twice per month. For assistance, contact IDFC FIRST Bank customer care at 1860 267 3333.
